headline: MGM Resorts (MGM) Stock Looks Undervalued On Cash Flow While Earnings Look Overvalued
summary: MGM Resorts International stock has returned 24.7% over the past year, yet the valuation checks send mixed signals as the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to upside while traditional market multiples lean the other way. With an active take‑private proposal in the background and the shares last closing at US$44.57, investors are weighing whether the current price already reflects the main pieces of the story.
